name: OKC_K_SALES_CREDITS_H
description:
Records sales credits for the sale of
                                         services in a contract. Functions in
                                         the same manner as sales credits in
                                         Order Management.

columns.name: ID
columns.description:
Surrogate key used for primary
                                               unique identifiers.

columns.name: DNZ_CHR_ID
columns.description:
Foreign Key: Maps to id in
                                               OKC_K_HEADERS_ALL_B table.
                                               Denormalized for performance.

columns.name: SALES_CREDIT_PUID
columns.description: Sales Credit PUID

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Major Version Number of the contract.

columns.name: PERCENT
columns.description:
The pecentage of the sales credit
                                               type the sales rep is to receive.

columns.name: SALESREP_ID
columns.description: ID1 for the sales representative.

columns.name: SALES_CREDIT_TYPE_ID
columns.description:
First part of foreign key to
                                               OKX_SALES_CRED_TYPES_V.

columns.name: ACTIVE_YN
columns.description:
Mandatory - Y|N, Indicates
                                               whether the sales credit
                                               information is interfaced to
                                               Receivables during billing.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CHR_ID
columns.description: Contracts header id.

columns.name: CLE_ID
columns.description:
Contracts line id - the service
                                               being sold.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: VERSION_TYPE
columns.description: Version Type can have 3 values: Current, Amendment, and History. If the version type is not Current then no update is allowed on the entity.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_KEY1
columns.description: External key that uniquely identifies a record.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_KEY2
columns.description: Additional attribute to qualify external key.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The effective start date of the sales credit.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The effective end date of the sales credit.
